reason: Enabling FIPS mode requires adding the fips=1 boot parameter, which modifies the bootloader configuration and forces the kernel to operate in FIPS mode. This change is not supported on an already installed system and can render the system unbootable or break cryptographic operations, making remediation high risk.
estimated_impact: reboot required; authentication/authorization affected; Potential system boot failure; Loss of cryptographic functionality; Possible lockout of authentication mechanisms; Incompatibility with existing software
